battle.name: 安史之亂
battle.theater: 河北范陽、河南洛陽與睢陽
battle.brief: 天寶十四載（755）十一月，安祿山以誅楊國忠為名在范陽起兵，十五萬眾南下，兩載而陷洛陽長安；至廣德元年（763）史朝義自盡幽州才告終。卡面羅馬方陣盾屬帝國時期軍團盾牆制式，未見於本役戰場；其遮蔽正面的職能，由唐軍方盾、拒馬與睢陽城防的弓弩分擔。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 安史之亂是天寶末年唐廷對安祿山、史思明所建叛軍的一場八年內戰，交戰主體是兩個漢語傳統與數支北方部族糾纏在一起的聯軍。唐朝一方在開元、天寶年間設置十餘處節度使，每鎮兼領軍政、財賦、州縣之政，兵權與財權集中於節度使之手；755年詔令討叛時，只是分派數路節度使各自出師，既無統一統帥，也無總參謀，河北、河南、山南、西川各線互不相屬，戰局遂由個別將領的臨機決斷決定。叛軍主力是安祿山以范陽、平盧、河東三鎮募得的蕃漢兵，雜有契丹、奚、室韋、靺鞨等北方部眾，騎兵比例高，安慶緒與史思明先後接掌並沿用其建制。安祿山死後，叛軍以洛陽為都建國號大燕，仍以奉密誅楊國忠為名號召天下。第三方之中，吐蕃在戰局末段趁虛攻入長安；回紇受邀出兵，與唐軍聯手收復洛陽；渤海亦曾遣兵助唐。而河朔與關中一批地方軍鎮在平叛過程中實力膨脹，轉為擁兵自重的藩鎮，成為此後百年的政治主角。
countriesEn: The An Lushan Rebellion was an eight-year civil war fought by the Tang court against the rebel army of An Lushan and Shi Siming, in which two Chinese traditions and several northern peoples were tangled together in the same coalitions. On the Tang side, the empire had created more than ten military districts during the Kaiyuan and Tianbao reigns; each jiedushi held military, fiscal, civil and prefectural authority in his circuit, so that troops and money were concentrated in his hands. When the court ordered the suppression of the revolt in 755 it merely told the various circuits to bring their own men, with no overall commander and no central staff: the northern, Henan, south-western and western lines never coordinated, and the shape of the war was decided by the ad hoc judgement of individual generals. The rebel main body was the mixed Chinese and 'fan' army An Lushan had raised in the three circuits of Fanyang, Pinglu and Hedong, with Caydar, Xi, Shiwei and Jie peoples folded into its ranks; cavalry made up a high proportion of it, and An Qingxu and Shi Siming inherited that organisation and kept it running. After An Lushan's death the rebels made Luoyang their capital, proclaimed the state of Yan, and went on raising the cry that they were carrying a secret order to execute Yang Guozhong. Among the third parties, the Tibetans entered Chang'an when the war was turning; the Uighurs were invited to send troops and fought beside the Tang to recover Luoyang; the kingdom of Bohai also sent men to the Tang side. And a number of regional commands in Hebei and Guanzhong, swollen by their part in the suppression, hardened into autonomous military governors, and became the political protagonists of the following century.
people: 安祿山是本場戰爭的起點人物。他營州柳城胡人，父為粟頂靺鞼，母改嫁安延偃，遂以安為姓，通蕃語，以驍捷與諂媚得玄宗歡心，先任平盧驅使、范陽節度使，後兼河東三節度使，握北方精兵與蕃兵。宰相楊國忠與之積不相能，屢進讒言並請削其兵權；天寶十四載春又催安祿山赴華清宮對證，安祿山於是偽稱奉密詔討楊國忠，在范陽開府點兵，一路由河北南下。哥舒翰在西面守住潼關，本可久拖，但朝廷逼他出關野戰，號稱二十萬之眾在關外的靈寶一線潰散，長安遂失，玄宗西幸成都，途中馬嵬驛禁軍譁變，楊貴妃被殺。太子李亨在朔方靈武即位，是為肅宗，郭子儀、李嗣業、李光弼等以勤王之名收復兩京。睢陽守將張巡以不足七千之眾拒叛軍十餘萬，圍城數月而援兵不至，城破時與姚誾等四十餘名將校同殉；南霽雲突出重圍乞援，並與史思明約鬥城下。僕固懷恩引回紇兵入援，魚朝恩以監軍身份節制諸軍，與郭子儀屢有齟齬。叛軍方面，安慶緒弒父自立，史思明復叛稱帝，最後又被自己的兒子史朝義所殺。
peopleEn: An Lushan was the man who set the war in motion. He was of mixed Hu stock from Liucheng in Yingzhou; his father was a Mohe with a tattooed crown of grain pattern, and his mother remarried into the An family, so that he took the surname An. He spoke the languages of the northern peoples and rose at court on his horsemanship and his ability to please, serving first in Pinglu and then as military governor of Fanyang until he held three circuits at once, Fanyang, Pinglu and Hedong, with the best troops of the north and the 'fan' auxiliaries in his hand. The chancellor Yang Guozhong could not stand him: he memorialised against him again and again and asked that his command be taken away, and in the spring of 755 he pressed the court to summon An to the Huaqing palace to answer the charges. An, reading that his own destruction had been written, forged the claim of a secret order to punish Yang Guozhong, mustered men and officials at Fanyang, and marched south through Hebei. Geshu Han held the pass at Tongguan in the west and could have prolonged the war there, but the court pressed him out into the open field, and his host of some two hundred thousand men was scattered outside the pass, near Lingbao; Chang'an was left open, Xuanzong fled west to Chengdu, and at Mawei the imperial guards mutinied and Consort Yang was killed. The crown prince Li Heng proclaimed himself emperor at Lingwu in the north and became Suzong, and men such as Guo Ziyi, Li Siye and Li Guangbi took up the cause of the new court and recovered the two capitals. Zhang Xun, who held Suiyang with fewer than seven thousand men against more than a hundred thousand rebels, was not relieved; when the city fell he died with it, together with Yao Yin and some forty other officers. Nan Jiyun broke out to beg for aid and fought a duel before the rebel camp. Pugu Huai'en brought the Uighur horse into the war, and Yu Chao'en, the eunuch supervisor, held the armies in his grasp and quarrelled constantly with Guo Ziyi. On the rebel side An Qingxu murdered his father to take the throne, Shi Siming rebelled again and proclaimed himself emperor, and in the end Shi Siming too was killed by his own son, Shi Chaoyi.
kits: 卡面是羅馬方陣盾，帝國時期軍團盾牆的制式裝備：凸面長方形，木胎蒙皮或綴以鐵片，寬約不及一米、高約一米二有餘，前緣弧曲。羅馬人把它排在密集的盾列中讓盾緣互相咬合，遮蔽正面並承受衝撞，盾後的步兵以短劍與標槍作戰；卡面 history 所說的靠盾緣咬住盾緣、不靠盾牌多厚，說的正是這面盾牆的用法。此盾不屬於本役的裝備序列，755年的幽州、黎陽、洛陽、睢陽戰場上不會出現羅馬盾牆。同期唐軍真正使用的是：遠射以弓與弩為主，唐弓張力大，弩有臂張、蹶張諸式，箭鏃以鐵為多；防護有明光鎧一類的鐵質札甲與鎖子甲，頭戴兜鍪、著冑，騎兵有披馬鎧的具裝騎兵，數量有限而衝鋒時效果顯著；近戰以陌刀、直刀、馬槊、長矛為主，唐刀柄常作環首以便懸腰。攻城器包括雲梯、懸車、撞車、飛梯與以投石為主的擲車，防守方則用拒馬、鹿角、木柵與藩籬。押運靠官馬、驛馬與牛車，軍糧大批由江淮經運河與長江水道北運，再自洛陽、潼關轉往前線；叛軍則以騎兵抄掠與就地徵發維持供應。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman scutum, the standard piece of the shield-wall of the imperial legions: a convex rectangle of wood faced with hide or plated with iron, a little under a metre wide and rather more than a metre and a quarter tall, with a curved front edge. The Romans set these in dense ranks so that one rim locked against the next, screening the front of the formation and taking the shock of a charge, while the infantry behind them fought with the short sword and the pilum. The card's remark that the line holds because rim grips rim rather than because the shield is thick states exactly how that wall worked. None of it belonged to the equipment sequence of this war: no Roman shield-wall stood on the fields of Youzhou, Liyang, Luoyang or Suiyang in 755. What the Tang army actually had was, first, the bow and the crossbow for ranged work, the Tang bow being powerful and the crossbow coming in braced and foot-operated forms, with iron arrowheads in the main. For protection there was bright-faced armour of the Mingguan type, wrought in iron in scales and bands, together with mail; troops wore the doumao and the zhou on the head, and the mounted men included armoured cavalry, limited in number but strikingly effective when they charged. At close quarters the line relied on the modao, the straight sabre, the cavalry lance and the long spear, and Tang sabres were commonly ring-pommelled so that they could be hung from the belt. The siege train included scaling ladders, the wheeled tower, ramming beams, wall-climbing frames and stone-throwing engines, while the defenders answered with the juma, the antler obstacle, wooden palisades and thorn hedges. Transport drew on the imperial horses, the post horses and ox carts, and the bulk of the army's grain was carried north from the Jiang-Huai by canal and Yangtze waterway and then relayed forward through Luoyang and Tongguan; the rebels, for their part, kept themselves supplied largely by mounted raiding and by taking what the country gave them.
tactics: 叛軍的戰術核心是騎兵的高速機動與分割配合。755年冬十五萬眾自范陽南下，河北州縣多望風迎降，唐軍被逼退守黃河南北的幾個點；756年五月，叛軍以精騎七百夜渡白沙河、掩襲黎陽不備，唐軍號稱十萬之眾在黃河兩岸被一點突破而潰散，說明密集大軍對分散騎兵的防禦極其脆弱。關鍵的失誤在潼關：哥舒翰據關拒守本可拖延，朝廷卻逼他出關野戰，號稱二十萬的大軍在關外的靈寶一線崩潰，長安遂無險可守。肅宗即位後戰局在河洛一線翻轉：757年唐軍與回紇、西域兵會合，步步為營逼近洛陽，李嗣業以陌刀隊為先鋒衝擊叛軍陣中，叛軍十餘萬眾大潰，陳利見被殺、崔乾祐被擒，安慶緒退保洛陽，唐軍九月入洛陽、十月進軍長安。防守方的技術在睢陽最為完整：張巡以弓弩交替射擊，拆毀攻城器械，出夜襲焚敵營，以拒馬與木柵堵塞缺口，全憑城垣與器械把敵人的速度化為它最缺乏的東西，就是時間；圍城歷數月而援兵不至，最後城破、將校殉難。攻守雙方都清楚糧道與節奏的價值：唐軍的糧食需自江淮北運，一旦洛陽與潼關的交通斷絕，前線即失續戰能力；叛軍靠抄掠維持，故其補給依賴不斷移動。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the rebels was the speed of their horse and the cutting power of their divisions. In the winter of 755 some hundred and fifty thousand men left Fanyang and moved south, and most of the prefectures of Hebei opened their gates to them, driving the Tang forces back onto a handful of points north and south of the Yellow River. In May 756 a rebel detachment of seven hundred picked riders crossed the Baisha river by night and fell on Liyang before it was ready; a Tang army called a hundred thousand was broken by that single point of entry, a demonstration of how fragile a massed host was against dispersed cavalry. The decisive blunder came at Tongguan. Geshu Han could have held the pass and held the war off there, but the court pressed him out to fight in the open, and his army of some two hundred thousand men was destroyed outside the pass, near Lingbao; Chang'an was left without defence. Once Suzong was on the throne the picture in the Luoyang-Henan line reversed. In 757 the Tang troops joined with the Uighurs and the men from the Western Regions, moved forward by cautious stages, and took the offensive; Li Siye led the assault with his modao columns and broke the rebel formations, more than a hundred thousand men routing completely, Chen Lijian being killed and Cui Qianyou taken alive, so that An Qingxu fell back into Luoyang and the Tang entered Luoyang in the ninth month and advanced into Chang'an in the tenth. The fullest expression of the defensive technique came at Suiyang, where Zhang Xun alternated the bow and the crossbow, broke up the enemy's siege engines, made night sorties to burn the camps and plugged the breaches with the juma and wooden barriers, using the wall and its works to convert the enemy's speed into the one thing it had none of, namely time. The siege dragged on for months without relief, and when the city was taken the officers died with it. Both sides understood the value of supply and of tempo: the Tang grain had to come north from the Jiang-Huai, and once the roads through Luoyang and Tongguan were cut the forward armies lost the means to keep fighting, while the rebels, living on plunder, had to keep moving to eat.
data: 有根據可寫的數字大致如下。起兵兵力：《舊唐書》與《資治通鑑》記安祿山以蕃兵及漢兵十五萬眾、號稱二十萬，自范陽南下。制度面，天寶年間全國置節度使十餘處，每鎮兵額自數萬至十餘萬不等，合計遠超中央禁軍，形成外重內輕之局；755年討叛的詔令只是分派數路節度使各出其兵，無大將總之，戰役因此拖成長期拉鋸。可繫於具體戰役的數字：756年黎陽之役，叛軍夜渡精騎七百即破唐軍；潼關之敗，哥舒翰所領號二十萬之眾潰散，還者數千；757年靈寶之戰，叛軍出動精兵十餘萬，唐軍與回紇、西域兵合為數萬，回紇精騎數千參戰，斬首以萬計；睢陽之圍，叛軍集兵十餘萬（一說十三萬），張巡所部與城守軍合計不足七千，圍城歷數月不下，城陷時張巡、姚誾等四十餘名將校殉難。763年史朝義敗亡於幽州，自755年11月起算，戰事歷時約八年。戶口與人口：《舊唐書·食貨志》載天寶末全國約九百餘萬戶，至廣德元年減至二百九十萬戶左右，跌幅約七成；但戶籍統計受逃戶、漏籍與僧道不入籍影響，與實數有出入，宜視為量級參考而非精確數字。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The strength of the rising, as the Jiu Tangshu and the Zizhi Tongjian record it, was a hundred and fifty thousand men of Chinese and 'fan' troops, called two hundred thousand, who marched south out of Fanyang. On the institutional side, the empire had more than ten military districts by the Tianbao era, each holding from several thousand to over a hundred thousand men, so that together they far outnumbered the central guards and the normal condition of the empire was weight outside and weakness within. The edict of 755 simply ordered the several circuits to bring their own troops, with no grand commander to coordinate them, which is why the campaign dragged on as a long series of separate actions. Numbers that can be fixed to particular engagements are these: at Liyang in 756 a rebel force of seven hundred picked riders who crossed the river by night broke a Tang army; at Tongguan the host Geshu Han commanded, called two hundred thousand, was scattered and only a few thousand returned; in the battle of Lingbao in 757 the rebels put more than a hundred thousand of their best troops into the field against several thousand Tang, Uighur and Western Regions men, with some thousands of Uighur horse, and the killed are put in the tens of thousands; at the siege of Suiyang the rebels massed more than a hundred thousand men, in one account a hundred and thirty thousand, against a garrison of less than seven thousand under Zhang Xun, and the siege lasted months without falling, when the city was taken and Zhang Xun, Yao Yin and some forty other officers died in it. The revolt ended with the defeat of Shi Chaoyi at Youzhou in 763, and counted from November 755 the whole affair lasted about eight years. As for households and population, the Jiu Tangshu on food and revenue gives rather more than nine hundred thousand households in the empire at the end of Tianbao and about two hundred and ninety thousand by the first year of Guangde, a fall of some seventy per cent; the registers were affected by flight, by omissions and by the fact that monks and nuns were not enrolled, so the figures are better read as an order of magnitude than as an exact count.
cause: 直接導火線是宰相與節度使之間的權力衝突。安祿山以胡人出身、遍習蕃語、驍捷善侍上，兼范陽、平盧、河東三節度使，握北方精兵與蕃兵，恩寵僅出於玄宗與楊貴妃之前；楊國忠以楊貴妃之兄任宰相，與之積不相能，屢請削奪其兵權、屢進讒言，並在天寶十四載催其入朝對證。安祿山自知死期將至，遂偽作密詔，稱奉密命討楊國忠，於范陽開府點兵、驅使蕃漢，一路由河北南下。深層原因在唐室的邊鎮體制：開元、天寶以來，節度使兼領軍、州、縣三政，有權募兵、屯田、加稅、任官；內地府兵制崩解而邊軍坐大，契丹、奚、室韋、靺鞨等內附部眾既為唐廷提供騎兵，也為叛軍提供兵源。於是清君側一套話術得以成立：叛軍以勤王之名起兵，卻很快露出改朝奪權的本意，中原的失序便由此鋪開。
causeEn: The immediate spark was a collision between the chancellor and the military governor. An Lushan, a man of mixed Hu stock who spoke the languages of the northern peoples, quick and skilled in pleasing the throne, held the three circuits of Fanyang, Pinglu and Hedong and the best of the northern and 'fan' troops with them, and he stood high in the favour of Xuanzong and of Consort Yang. Yang Guozhong, chancellor and brother of the consort, was on bad terms with him: he petitioned again and again to strip An of his command, memorialised against him repeatedly, and in 755 pressed for him to be summoned to the capital to answer the charges. An, who understood that his own death had been written, forged the claim of carrying a secret order to punish Yang Guozhong, raised officials and mustered Chinese and 'fan' troops at Fanyang, and marched south through Hebei. Behind the spark lay the institutional fault of the border commands. From Kaiyuan and Tianbao onward the military governor held military, civil and fiscal power over his prefectures and counties, and could raise troops, farm land, levy taxes and appoint officials; the old militia system of the interior had collapsed while the armies of the frontier grew larger and larger; and groups such as the Caydar, Xi, Shiwei and Jie, settled within the frontier, supplied the Tang with cavalry and at the same time supplied the rebels with theirs. In that setting the rhetoric of cleansing the court of evil ministers could take hold: the rebels rose in the name of the dynasty, and within a few months revealed that what they were after was power, and the collapse of order in the central plains followed from it.
impact: 八年的戰亂把唐帝國的結構改寫了。政治上，玄宗西幸成都、太子在靈武另立朝廷，統一帝國的合法性斷為二，宦官監軍成為常制，節度使兼掌軍政財的格局在平亂中被進一步確認，藩鎮自此不可逆轉：河朔的成德、魏博、盧龍等鎮在亂後擁兵自重，中晚唐的割據局面由此開始，中央對河北與關中的一致控制難再恢復。制度上，兩京淪陷使均田與租庸調的基盤崩壞，戶籍大量散失，募兵取代府兵，成為延續數百年之制；建中元年（780）楊炎所行兩稅法，以資產代替人丁，正是戰後戶籍崩壞與諸鎮截留的產物，而劉晏整頓鹽運之後，財賦重心移到江淮。經濟與人口上，約九百餘萬戶降至二百九十萬戶的量級跌幅，說明北方農業與戶籍體系的崩壞之深，河北數州到中唐仍呈千里蕭條之狀。對外關係上，吐蕃趁亂入長安，回紇受邀出兵平叛而索重酬，開了外族干政的先例。文化上，杜甫的兵車行與三吏三別把戰亂實況寫成詩史，安史之亂此後成為亂世與流離的代名詞。
impactEn: Eight years of war rewrote the structure of the Tang empire. Politically, the flight to Chengdu and the proclamation of a rival court at Lingwu broke the legitimacy of the unified state in two; the eunuch supervisor became a permanent institution; and the combination of military, civil and fiscal authority in the hands of the military governor was confirmed by the war itself, so that the autonomous commands were thereafter irreversible. Ch'eng-te, Wei-po and Lu-lung in the north held their own troops and answered to nobody, the divided order of the middle and late Tang begins here, and the central government's uniform control of Hebei and Guanzhong was never fully restored. Institutionally, the loss of the two capitals broke the foundations of equal-field tenure and of the tax system based on labour and silk, the registers were scattered, and recruitment replaced the old militia for the several centuries to come; the two-tax system put into effect by Yang Yan in 780, taxing property instead of persons, was the direct product of a ruined register and of governors keeping back their revenues, and once Liu Yan had reorganised the salt transport the centre of fiscal life moved to the Jiang-Huai. Economically and demographically, the fall from rather more than nine hundred thousand households to about two hundred and ninety thousand shows how deeply the agricultural and registration system of the north had broken down, several prefectures of Hebei still described in the middle Tang as a thousand li of desolation. In foreign affairs, the Tibetans entered Chang'an while the empire was in extremity, and the Uighurs were invited to send troops, paid heavily for it, and set the precedent of foreign troops deciding Tang affairs. In culture, Du Fu's “Song of the Army Carts” and his “Three Officials” and “Three Farewells” turned the war into documentary poetry, and the name of the rebellion has ever since stood for disorder, exile and ruin.
result: 就結果而言，叛軍在763年被平定：史思明於761年被其子史朝義所殺，史朝義在幽州兵敗自剄，割據八年的燕國覆滅。但唐廷的收復只限於旗號：兩京於757年回吐，河北與河朔各鎮實質不歸中央，伊洛與河北一帶在往後數十年成為藩鎮互相攻伐的戰場，官軍屢次收復又屢次失去。叛軍敗亡的內在原因也清楚：安祿山被兒子安慶緒與宮中內侍合殺，史思明又被自己的兒子史朝義所弒，軍隊與部眾的效忠從未建立在共同目標上，只建立在劫掠與恐懼上，軍紀與補給都難以長期維持。唐廷得到的另一個教訓更為重要：外重內輕的兵制、空虛的中樞，以及過度依賴蕃兵與胡將的軍隊，一旦遇上真有政治野心的人便難以收拾。於是這場戰爭同時是叛軍的失敗與唐朝的轉折——它結束了開元天寶的盛世，開啟了藩鎮並立、宦官監軍、藩鎮用兵的晚唐格局。
resultEn: As for the outcome, the rebels were destroyed in 763: Shi Siming was killed by his son Shi Chaoyi in 761, and Shi Chaoyi was beaten at Youzhou and killed himself, and the Yan state, independent for eight years, came to an end. What the Tang recovered, however, was the name only. The two capitals were retaken in 757, while Hebei and the northern circuits in practice no longer answered to the centre, and the belt of Luoyang and the Yellow River became for the decades afterwards a battleground in which the autonomous governors attacked one another, the imperial troops taking cities and losing them again and again. The inner reason for the rebels' collapse is equally clear: An Lushan was killed by his own son An Qingxu together with a palace eunuch, and Shi Siming was killed by his own son Shi Chaoyi. The loyalty of troops and peoples to the rebel cause was never built on a common purpose but on plunder and terror, and discipline and supply could not be sustained. The Tang drew the larger lesson of the other kind: a military system weighted towards the frontier, an empty centre, and an army too dependent on 'fan' auxiliaries and non-Chinese commanders could not be pulled back once a man with real political ambition moved against it. The war was therefore at once the defeat of the rebels and the turning point of the dynasty. It ended the Kaiyuan-Tianbao prosperity and opened the late Tang order of rival commands, eunuch supervisors and armies raised by the autonomous governors.
